mapper.insert: insert into rtks_role_match_record (`user_id`, `role_id`, `match`, `create_time`, `update_time`) values (#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{match}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select rtks_role_match_record.user_id, rtks_role_match_record.role_id, rtks_role.name as role_name, rtks_role.level_id, rtks_role_match_record.`match` from rtks_role_match_record inner join rtks_role on rtks_role_match_record.role_id = rtks_role.resource_id
select rtks_role_match_record.create_time from rtks_role_match_record order by id limit 1
